scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm db:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:staging: SITE_ENV=staging opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: SITE_ENV=production opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env production
scripts.db:check:search: drizzle-kit check --config drizzle.search.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.search.config.ts | grep -q 'No schema changes' && scripts/search-d1/schema.sh | diff src/db/search-schema.sql -
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply zenbujapanese-web-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply zenbujapanese-web-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrations:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list zenbujapanese-web-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrations:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list zenbujapanese-web-production --remote --env production
